articles.title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
articles.description: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls below $60K for first time since July amid broader market selloff
articles.description: Bitcoin fell nearly 6% as US stocks declined, with the Nasdaq dropping more than 2% and Anthropic shares losing almost 10%.

articles.title: US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act
articles.description: The Senate-approved bill would ban prediction market contracts tied to war, assassination and death amid concerns over potential insider trading on military events.

articles.title: Bitcoin price drops to $60K as Anthropic drops to $87 in tech sell-off
articles.description: Bitcoin price strength felt pressure from falling US equities as traders reassessed AI prospects after Anthropic’s IPO.

articles.title: DBS bets it can lose the deposit and keep the client
articles.description: The Singapore bank earned a record $208 million in transaction services fees in the third quarter — now it’s helping companies turn deposits into stablecoins they can spend without it.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Lagarde warns Europe could miss chance to unify tokenized markets
articles.description: The ECB president said Europe’s market for tokenized securities could split into platforms that cannot settle trades with one another.

articles.title: Binance hacker moves nearly $600M in ETH, routes funds through THORChain, Chainflip
articles.description: OnChain Lens tracked nearly $600 million in ETH transfers over two days as the Binance hackers moved the stolen funds through fresh wallets and cross-chain protocols to obscure their trail.

articles.title: VanEck to end Gemini ETF custody deals, keeps Coinbase
articles.description: VanEck plans to end Gemini’s custody agreements for three crypto ETFs in February 2027, while Coinbase will continue serving as a custodian for the funds.

articles.title: Bitcoin nears repeat of chart pattern that preceded 2023’s $25K retest
articles.description: Bitcoin’s 21-day moving average fell below its 200-day average, and analyst Keith Alan expects a second bearish crossover by Sunday.

articles.title: BlackRock’s IBIT loses record $541M amid Anthropic market debut
articles.description: BlackRock’s IBIT posted its largest daily outflow on record, taking three-session outflows near $900 million as BTC dipped amid a broader market selloff.

articles.title: SEC charges 8 firms over fake crypto platforms tied to $37M fraud
articles.description: The SEC says the operators showed investors fake certificates and pointed them to filings on the agency’s website as proof of regulatory approval.

articles.title: Anthropic’s $81B IPO draws half the net retail buying of SpaceX’s
articles.description: Retail investors traded $772 million in Anthropic shares on Thursday, the most Vanda Research has recorded for a market debut since 2012.

articles.title: Institutions pile back into US Bitcoin ETFs in Q3 after selling streak
articles.description: Asset managers added the equivalent of 49,229 Bitcoin to their US Bitcoin ETF holdings in the third quarter, reversing three quarters of net selling.

articles.title: Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet to leave after nine years at company
articles.description: Guillemet helped establish Ledger’s Donjon security lab and says his departure has been planned for months.

articles.title: Binance’s $6.5B freeze order, Hong Kong ‘suspicious’ of HYPE: Asia Express
articles.description: Binance obtains court orders freezing assets stolen in October’s hack. Hong Kong warns citizens about Hyperliquid, and Thai police arrest four foreigners linked to a crypto scam.

articles.title: MoonPay seeks US bank charter for stablecoin, custody services
articles.description: MoonPay’s proposed national trust bank would offer stablecoin issuance and redemption, reserve management and digital asset custody under federal oversight.

articles.title: Hyperliquid Anthropic futures priced within 1% of Nasdaq opening price
articles.description: Hyperliquid traders priced Anthropic futures within 1% of the stock’s Nasdaq opening price, as trading surged ahead of the AI company’s IPO.

articles.title: Trump’s SEC nominee Johnson backs formal rulemaking for tokenized stock trading
articles.description: Former CFTC Commissioner and Democrat Kristin Johnson and ex-SEC aide Steven Levine appeared before lawmakers Thursday.

articles.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
articles.description: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.

articles.title: Why higher rates could slow Bitcoin buying at treasury firms
articles.description: A treasury company can have years of dividends covered and still struggle to sell new shares on terms that make another Bitcoin purchase worthwhile.

articles.title: Bitcoin price ignores Anthropic debut as ANT share price dips below $100
articles.description: Bitcoin dropped toward a third retest of $62,000 as Anthropic debuted on the Nasdaq, hitting highs of $115 per share before dropping below $100.

articles.title: Anthropic shares open at $111.50, 34.3% above $83 IPO price
articles.description: The Claude chatbot maker began trading under the ticker ANT, with the company’s valuation at around $2 trillion at the opening price.

articles.title: Ethereum’s new DeFi security tool raises questions over censorship
articles.description: Phylax’s system lets decentralized protocols block potentially harmful transactions, but raises questions about potential censorship and Ethereum’s concentrated builder market.

articles.title: Hong Kong adds Hyperliquid to list of ‘suspicious’ crypto platforms
articles.description: Hong Kong’s securities regulator said Hyperliquid has no local license and may have promoted its trading services to investors in the city.

articles.title: GTA VI publisher racks up nearly 3x Nvidia’s tokenized stock volume
articles.description: Tokenized Take-Two shares drew $249.5 million in DEX volume Wednesday, nearly three times the $88.1 million for tokenized Nvidia shares.

articles.title: Sweden’s H100 could tap Bitcoin trading pool to fund share buybacks
articles.description: Shareholders will vote Dec. 7 on whether H100 can buy back up to 10% of its shares, potentially using a Bitcoin pool that lost about 30 BTC in Q3.

articles.title: IOSCO warns quantum upgrades could slow blockchains, leave security gaps
articles.description: A Solana test network ran about 90% slower with quantum-resistant signatures, and wallets that keep using older keys could remain vulnerable.

articles.title: Singapore settles $77.5M tokenized bill sale with wholesale CBDC
articles.description: MAS issued the bills directly on its test network, which it plans to rename SG Digital Ledger and use for settlement beyond the trials.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF assets fall to three-month low as 2026 net outflows top $2.5B
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $306.4 million Wednesday, pushing their combined assets to $77.7 billion as Bitcoin briefly traded below $63,000.
